samples.question: Each gray line in this picture is one straight wire running between two ports on the ring. Where two wires cross, one of them is drawn with a short break on either side of the other wire: the wire with the breaks passes UNDERNEATH, and the unbroken wire passes OVER it. Exactly one port is green, and exactly one wire starts there. Follow the wire that starts at the green port all the way to its other port. How many times does that wire pass underneath another wire? Answer with a single number: 0, 1, 2, or 3.
